I can’t access or change your calendar (no calendar tools available). Before I give step-by-step instructions and a ready-to-send cancellation message, I need two quick confirmations so I cancel exactly what you want:

1) Scope — do you want to cancel:
   - A: Both recurring series (Tuesdays 09:00 CT with 12 attendees and Thursdays 15:00 CT with 4 attendees), or
   - B: Only the Tuesday series, or
   - C: Only the Thursday series?

2) Effect and notifications — do you want to:
   - 1) Cancel the recurring series entirely (all future occurrences) starting tomorrow (i.e., make the change effective immediately), and send calendar cancellation notices to attendees (recommended), or
   - 2) Cancel only the upcoming occurrences for a period (please specify end date), or
   - 3) Remove the events from your calendar without sending cancellations to attendees?

If you confirm (e.g., “Cancel both series, cancel all future occurrences, and notify attendees”), I’ll provide:
- A concise cancellation subject + message you can paste into the calendar cancellation,
- Exact next-occurrence dates/times (America/Chicago) that will be affected,
- Step-by-step instructions for cancelling a meeting series in Google Calendar and in Outlook, including which option to choose to cancel the series and send notifications.

If you prefer, I can draft the cancellation text now. Sample (editable) cancellation message I’ll send if you confirm notifications:

Subject: Cancellation — Operations Sync (weekly)

Body:
Hello all —  
We are canceling the weekly “Operations Sync” meetings effective immediately. Please do not attend future recurring sessions. If you have agenda items that still need discussion, reply here or reach out to [your name] directly and we’ll schedule follow-ups as needed. Thank you.

— [Your name / team]

Confirm your choices and I’ll produce the exact cancellation message and the platform-specific steps.
